scientific_integrity: Exact finite Chow-ring residues with a second localization computation. Hodge data in Fatighenti–Mongardi are acknowledged as prior results. No assertion of external or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Smooth complex ten-hyperplane sections of Gr(2,10) only. Numerical tangent Chern class intersections, not primitive algebraic cycles or full integral cohomology. Previously published Hodge numbers and Euler characteristic are expressly not new; earlier implicit numerical coverage remains a literature risk.
title: Complete polarized Chern-number table of the Grassmannian Calabi–Yau sixfold
